SELECT IFNULL(c.contract_id, pa.application_id) AS contractId, u.name AS freelancerName, c.contract_start_date AS startDate, c.contract_end_date AS endDate, c.total_budget AS budget, p.communicate_method AS communicateMethod, c.payment_method AS paymentMethod, p.max_revision_count AS maxRevisionCount, c.origin_contract_url AS originContractUrl,
cm.milestone_id AS milestoneId, cm.contract_id AS contractId, cm.step_order AS stepOrder, cm.milestone_name AS milestoneName, cm.amount AS amount, cm.due_date AS dueDate, cm.status AS status FROM projects p INNER JOIN project_applications pa ON p.project_id = pa.project_id LEFT JOIN contracts c ON pa.application_id = c.contract_id LEFT JOIN users u ON pa.freelancer_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN contract_milestones cm ON c.contract_id = cm.contract_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND (pa.application_status = 'CONTRACTED' OR c.contract_status = 'SIGNED') ORDER BY cm.step_order ASC
